events.title: Netscape Navigator 1.0 shipped
events.summary: [Netscape] Communications released Navigator 1.0 on December 15, 1994 — the commercial browser that defined the mid-1990s web and set the pace of the browser wars.
events.about: Navigator bundled fast rendering, SSL for secure shopping, and cookies for session state — the stack behind early e-commerce and portal sites. Built by many of the [Mosaic] authors, it quickly became the browser most people associated with "the internet" before [Microsoft]'s response.

narrative.whyChosen: [Netscape] turned the web into a product category and a public-company story.
narrative.whyImportant: It set de-facto web features (SSL, cookies, rapid releases) that every competitor had to match.
narrative.problemSolved: The web needed a supported, fast, cross-platform browser backed by a company that could drive standards and ship updates weekly.
